episodes.synopsis: Takumi Kayano died due to a mistake made by a god. As an apology, the god sends him to another world and revives him. As Takumi makes his way through this new world, he finds two small children in the forest.
episodes.title: Another World and Twins

episodes.synopsis: Takumi has gradually gotten used to his new life and the new world. However, there is one thing he is not happy about at all: the limited selection of bread.
episodes.title: Nice to Meet You, Joule

episodes.synopsis: Takumi and the twins are invited on an expedition. The three of them try to hold back their powers, but they feel a menacing gaze fixed on them.
episodes.title: Monster Hunting!

episodes.synopsis: The expedition makes its way through the forest, but something seems off. There are far too few monsters appearing. Then Takumi finally discovers the truth behind the eerie gaze.
episodes.title: Taku Gets Mad

episodes.synopsis: Takumi and the twins take on a new mission, but the guild members and villagers are unsure if they are up to the task. After a tough battle, Takumi's animal companions evolve and have a surprise in store.
episodes.title: We're Gonna Beat the Goblins!

episodes.synopsis: Takumi is confronted by a slave trader who sees Allen and Elena as his merchandise. A guard quickly arrives to resolve the situation. How can Takumi resolve this and set off to the sea with the twins?
episodes.title: The Ocean! It's Salty!

episodes.synopsis: Takumi and the children helped the merfolk and were generously rewarded. They head to a small island to finally master water magic, but then they encounter a strange monster.
episodes.title: Mermaids! Dragons!

episodes.synopsis: Takumi bids farewell to the Azure Palace and continues on his way to Bailey. Along the way, he discovers a dungeon with 30 levels and decides to explore it a bit.
episodes.title: Crab! Crab!

episodes.synopsis: After arriving in Bailey, Takumi first talks with Syl and receives some news and gifts. Then he heads to the Adventurer's Guild, where a great commotion suddenly breaks out.
episodes.title: What's a Dad?

episodes.synopsis: Takumi has a conversation with Cedric, the lord of Bailey. Cedric shows particular interest in the food that Takumi has introduced to the land. Cedric's sons also seem enthusiastic.
episodes.title: I Hope We Can Make Friends...

episodes.synopsis: Takumi has found the trading company that owns the sunken ship. When he returns it, he is introduced to a variety of interesting spices. An idea for a new dish immediately comes to mind!
episodes.title: Vector Does a Good Job!

episodes.synopsis: Takumi arrives once again at Cedric's place with the twins, and Cedric immediately has a request for him. Next up is a dungeon that they haven't yet completed. What awaits them down there?
episodes.title: Bye-Bye! See You Next Time!
